info.name: NurseSync Handoff API
info.description:
Test collection for the NurseSync Nurse Shift Handoff API.

Set the 'base_url' variable to your server address before running.
Default: http://localhost:8000

Routes marked [FUTURE] are not yet implemented — they are pre-built here so the collection is ready when routes are added.

request.description: Verify the server is running and configured correctly. Should return 200 with model name and timestamp.
